title: Covseisnet: covariance matrix analysis of network seismic data
description: Covseisnet is a Python package for array signal processing, with a focus on data from seismic networks. The core mathematical object of the package is the network covariance matrix, used for signal detection, source separation, localisation, and plane-wave beamforming. Version 2 is a complete rewrite of the original package (https://github.com/covseisnet/covseisnet).
